review_notes: The file contains only theorems and no new definitions, structures or classes, so it adds no competing concept. I read all three theorems. Monic.resultant_map_map is a monic specialisation of Mathlib's Polynomial.resultant_map_map, which takes explicit degree indices. Monic.isCoprime_map_iff covers a general unit-reflecting map between commutative rings. Mathlib's Polynomial.isCoprime_map (FieldDivision.lean:493) covers only field maps and does not require monicity, so the two results overlap only on monic field inputs. The file's docstring says this. The third theorem records the overlap by proof irrelevance and does not create a parallel API. This is a theorem-level specialisation and is outside the rubric's concept-duplication scope. I found no justified finding.
